source: GRADING_CONTRACT.md common labels (verbatim definitions) + our boundary notes and illustrative examples. Examples are written by us; none is drawn from the golden 50.

access.definition: Login, signup, password or account access
access.boundary: Cannot log in, verification code never arrives, account hacked/locked, forced logout. A subscription that will not activate is billing, not access.
examples: It keeps logging me out and the reset email never comes.
Can't sign in with Facebook anymore.

usability.definition: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions
usability.boundary: UI redesigns, buttons moved, queue/shuffle controls, too many or too long ads, widget/lockscreen controls. Explicitly premium-only controls (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium') go to billing.
examples: The new home screen is cluttered and I can't find my library.
Three ads after every song is ridiculous.

playback.definition: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use
playback.boundary: Songs stop/skip by themselves, app crashes or freezes, won't connect, Bluetooth/car/Chromecast playback, battery or data drain, sound quality.
examples: Music stops every time I lock my phone.
App crashes on launch since the update.

downloads.definition: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads
downloads.boundary: Downloads vanish, offline mode doesn't work, can't download, storage location. Liked songs/library disappearing also counts as saved music.
examples: Downloaded songs stop playing when I go offline.
All my downloads disappeared again.

catalog.definition: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability
catalog.boundary: Song greyed out/unavailable, search returns wrong results, poor recommendations/Discover Weekly, lyrics missing, podcasts/audiobook content availability, content policy/removal of artists.
examples: Lyrics are gone for most songs now.
Search never finds the artist I type.

billing.definition: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement; explicitly premium-only controls go here
billing.boundary: Charged twice, price increase, refund, premium not activating, 'have to pay premium to choose songs/skip', free-tier skip limits framed as a paywall. Merely mentioning that the user is premium is NOT billing.
examples: They charged me after I cancelled.
You can't even play the song you pick unless you pay.

support.definition: Contacting support and the support response
support.boundary: Customer service unreachable, no reply, bot-only support, unhelpful agent.
examples: Support just sends me the same copy-paste answer.
There is no way to contact a human.

other.definition: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic
other.boundary: 'Great app', 'worst app', emoji only, unrelated text, unsupported language with no recoverable meaning, political/boycott slogans with no product issue.
examples: Best app ever!
Bad.

topic_rules: Classify the review text itself; stars/metadata never substitute for the text.
Choose the problem with the highest supported severity; on a tie, the first specific problem mentioned.
For a positive review, choose the first specific praised feature; general praise is other.
Mentioning a paid plan alone does not make the topic billing. A subscription failing to activate does; music crashing for a paying customer is playback.

intents.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, switching to a competitor, or threatening to do so.
intents.complaint: Negative experience, including mixed praise/criticism. General 'bad app' is a complaint (topic other).
intents.request: Desired change or feature without a reported failure.
intents.unclear: Bare boycott slogans, unrelated or meaningless text, or language we cannot interpret.

1.meaning: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request
examples: Love it
Please add a sleep timer to podcasts

2.meaning: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss
examples: Worst app
Don't like the new colours
Too many ads

3.meaning: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains
examples: Songs skip sometimes
Lyrics missing on some tracks
Shuffle keeps repeating the same songs
Can only skip 6 times an hour without premium

4.meaning: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music
examples: Can't log in at all
App crashes every time I open it
No song will play

5.meaning: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm; an expensive plan, a crash, or angry language alone is insufficient
examples: Charged three times and refused a refund
My account was hacked and my card was used
They lost my entire 10-year library

severity_rules: Stars, angry language, or cancellation intent alone do not establish severity.
Missing context should set needs_review; do not invent impact.
sentiment: Float in [-1, 1] from the text's emotional tone: -1 very negative, -0.5 negative, 0 neutral/mixed, 0.5 positive, 1 very positive. Evaluation tolerance: |pred - human| <= 0.5.
evidence_quote: An exact, unmodified substring of review_text that supports the topic/intent. Short reviews may use the full text.
entities: Product features, devices or named services explicitly mentioned (e.g. 'shuffle', 'lyrics', 'Android Auto', 'premium'). No inferred entities.
needs_review: True when the text is ambiguous, unsupported-language, sarcastic, or lacks context for a confident label.
